title: Scaffolding Permit
name: Scaffolding Permit
description: Permit for scaffold erection, alteration, use and dismantling with design, competent erection, handover, inspection and access controls.

sections.title: DESIGN, FOUNDATIONS AND ERECTION
items: Scaffold is a recognised configuration or suitably designed
Current design drawings are available where required
Ground and foundations are suitable
Scaffolders and supervision are competent
Erection / alteration / dismantling controls fall risk
Ties and bracing follow the required arrangement
Unverified permanent works are not relied on for stability
Interfaces with adjacent works are coordinated

fields.label: Fall Prevention Method During Erection / Alteration / Dismantling

sections.title: PLATFORMS, EDGE PROTECTION AND ACCESS
items: Working platforms are complete and suitable
Guardrails and toe boards are provided where required
Openings and ladder access points are protected
Safe access is provided and secured
Falling-object controls are provided
Loading-bay gates are protected
Unauthorised access is controlled

sections.title: LOADING AND USE RESTRICTIONS
items: Intended loads are within design capacity
Load restrictions are communicated
Sheeting, hoists and attachments are allowed by design
Only authorised people alter the scaffold
Users know to stop use after damage or movement

fields.label: Sheeting / Netting / Hoists / Chutes / Other Attachments

sections.title: HANDOVER AND INSPECTION
items: Scaffold is inspected before first use
Handover / inspection record identifies restrictions
Statutory inspections are scheduled at required intervals
Re-inspection follows alteration or adverse events
Inspection records identify defects and actions
Unsafe scaffolds are taken out of use

sections.title: AUTHORIZATION AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Permit holder understands scaffold restrictions
Alterations are by authorised scaffolders only
Dismantling retains exclusion and falling-object controls
Ties / openings are made safe after dismantling
Area is safe for hand-back
